nodes.label: Ollama-native /api/chat coupling
nodes.source_file: Fresh Brief Spark Qwen Migration Requirements.md
nodes.source_location: § Why a URL change is insufficient
nodes.rationale: app.py model_points and newsroom.py local_json use Ollama body/response; SQLite saved model overrides compose env; start.ps1 starts Ollama, so URL change alone is insufficient

nodes.label: OpenAI-mode JSON adapter specification
nodes.source_file: Fresh Brief Spark Qwen Migration Requirements.md
nodes.notes: LLM_PROVIDER=openai, LLM_BASE_URL, LLM_MODEL=qwen38-27b-spark, LLM_API_KEY; json_schema strict response_format; output limits gist 1500/notes 1800/default 2600/essays 6000; 180/240 s timeouts

nodes.label: SSH forward to Spark loopback LM Studio
nodes.source_file: Fresh Brief Spark Qwen Migration Requirements.md
nodes.rationale: Preferred: keeps Spark 1234 on loopback; never bind 0.0.0.0

nodes.label: No cross-provider silent fallback
nodes.source_file: Fresh Brief Spark Qwen Migration Requirements.md
nodes.rationale: Never retry on Windows Ollama when Spark fails; surface sanitized dependency error and preserve editions

nodes.label: Cutover and preservation procedure
nodes.source_file: Fresh Brief Spark Qwen Migration Requirements.md
nodes.notes: backup SQLite with WAL; never docker compose down -v; brief_data volume; twice_daily schedule
